description: Prompt injection detection, scan untrusted text before an AI agent reads it. Scan text (a web page, email, document or tool output) for known prompt-injection patterns before giving it to an AI agent: instruction overrides, fake system tags, jailbreak phrases, data-exfiltration and payment instructions, hidden characters. Returns a 0-100 risk score, a level and each matched pattern. It is a rule-based pattern check and CAN MISS attacks; it is not a guarantee of safety. Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).
name: injection_check
